en.description:
From Critter Games.

Someone finally made good fidget toys for the Apple Watch.

WatchPop is a collection of tactile toys built for the wrist. Roll a marble around a walnut bowl with the Digital Crown and feel it coast and settle. Pop a sheet of bubble wrap that never runs out. Flick a spinner and let it wind down past the marker. Tilt your wrist to roll a ball through a maze, and a fresh one slides in when it drops out the far side. Real physics runs under every toy, and every toy carries its own haptics, so each one answers your hand in its own way.

PLAY IT WITH ONE HAND

On watchOS 27, pinch your index finger and thumb to work the toy in front of you: pop the next bubble, flick the spinner, advance the dial a stop, scatter the pile.

Hand gestures need a watch with Double Tap, and Gestures turned on in Settings. Every toy still works by touch and Digital Crown without them.

ONE PINCH FROM THE WATCH FACE

Put the WatchPop widget in your Smart Stack and the toy you played last opens in a tap, with no menu on the way.

THE TOYS

Seven are free, forever:
Marble Bowl, a marble that rolls and settles under the crown.
Bubble Wrap, an endless sheet, one pop per tap.
Spinner, flick it and let it wind down past the marker.
Block Buddies, a pile of plushies to tilt, tumble, and scatter.
Combination Dial, turn through felt detents and feel the tumbler fall.
Zipper, one ratcheting tick per tooth, up and back down.
Watch Winder, the open heart of a mechanical watch: wind the crown, hear every tooth click, and watch the gears run down.

The paid toys each play two ways, by finger and by wrist:
Pop Pad, press each dome with a thunk or sweep a whole row, turn the crown to flip the grid.
Tilt Stone, a stone that rolls up the side of the bowl when you turn your wrist, then finds its way home.
Critters, a little face to pet until its eyes close or fling and watch tumble, with six critters on the crown.
Tilt Maze, tilt a ball through a fresh maze and out the far side, then do it again.

And two Halloween toys: the jack-o'-lantern, whose carved light sweeps the page as you lean your wrist, and Spooky Critters, a witch, a skeleton and a bat to pet and fling.

FOUR FINISHES

Workshop is free for everyone: warm walnut and brass. Machine is all metal, brushed steel and harder highlights. Studio is flat and modern, gradient white and pastel teal. Halloween is a spooky dusk, carved and glowing, and comes with the Halloween purchase. A finish reskins your whole collection, art and palette together.

BUDDIES

Little companions for your wrist: pet them, feed them a treat, spin them with the crown. Sprout is free. Cats, Dogs, Dinos and Cosmic sell one pack at a time or all together. The Halloween purchase adds six Halloween buddies.

WHAT IT COSTS

The free toys are complete and stay complete. Nothing in the app expires, runs out, or asks you to come back tomorrow. No ads, no timers, no energy meters, no loot boxes, no subscriptions, nothing to grind, and no score to beat.

Buy something once and it restores, on your watch and your iPhone, with Family Sharing on. The best value is the Founder's Set: all four paid toys plus the Machine and Studio finishes in one purchase, yours to keep. Halloween and the Buddies packs are sold separately.

BUILT TO BE QUIET

WatchPop works with no connection. Mute means mute, and a haptic sits behind every sound. Lower your wrist and the toy freezes where it stands instead of draining your battery inside your sleeve. Nothing here sends a notification.

VOICEOVER AND REDUCE MOTION

Every toy carries a VoiceOver label and speaks its state in words, with direct touch and custom actions for the ones you tap or drag. Crown toys are adjustable, one stop per swipe. Turn on Reduce Motion and the toys answer your hand just as fast, while the long coasts and tumbles settle short.

The iPhone app holds the gallery, the finishes, and the settings. The toys live on the watch, which is where your hands already are.
en.releaseNotes:
New toy: the Watch Winder. The Ratchet Wrench is now the inside of a real mechanical watch. Turn the Digital Crown or circle a finger on the screen to wind it, feel every tooth click, then watch the gears and balance wheel run down.

Fresh looks for three favorites: a brass zipper on canvas, a knurled combination dial, and a soft silicone Pop Pad, in all four finishes.

Plus a cleaner Studio preview and small fixes.
